scope: Independent whole-suite and static verification at the exact target using official Bun 1.4.2 in a disposable detached checkout at /tmp/opencode/rev49/review; no cloud, model-provider or real-infrastructure smoke; no source changes in /workspace/repo.

findings.title: No CI run of the test suite on branches or pull requests
findings.evidence: code-evidenced: triggers are `on: push: tags: [v*]` and `workflow_dispatch` only (.github/workflows/release.yml:7-11). `find .github -type f` shows this is the repository's only workflow, and its `Test` and `Static checks` steps live inside the release job, gated on a tag already existing.
findings.reproduction: Inspect .github/workflows/release.yml:7-11 and confirm no pull_request or branch-push trigger exists in the repository. Not runtime-reproducible because the defect is an absent trigger.
findings.recommendation: Add a separate read-only workflow triggered on pull_request and branch push that runs `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, `bun test` and `bun run check` with Bun pinned to 1.4.2, keeping it distinct from the tag-gated release job so write permission stays limited to the draft job.

verified_non_findings: Per-test timeouts are explicit, not accidental: Bun 1.4.2 default is 5000ms and a 6s test with no timeout fails at 5002ms, but the slowest packaging tests (5.34-5.83s measured) declare 120000ms budgets (tests/packaging.test.ts:163 beforeAll 300000, :197 afterAll 60000 added by target HEAD d428e0f, per-test 120000).
Suite is non-vacuous: disabling the URL-userinfo redaction at src/security.ts:18 in the disposable checkout made `bun test` fail 5 tests (exit 1); mutation reverted.
No leaked state: serve/lifecycle/process-lock/session-status re-run in isolation matched in-suite counts (20/34/3/12 pass); no /tmp/swarmforge-* leftovers and no stray processes after full runs.

No vacuous assertions, no @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck, no `: any`/`as any`, no eslint-disable, one deliberate biome-ignore (tests/settings.test.ts:714), no TODO/FIXME in src, tests or scripts.
No real-provider reachability in tests: only .example/.invalid/loopback host literals; src network I/O is src/providers/freestyle.ts:21 plus the ServerHandle.fetch interface.

Toolchain floor is declared and tested (engines.bun >=1.4.2, packageManager bun@1.4.2, tests/packaging.test.ts:844, workflow pins 1.4.2); Bun 1.3.14 fails install with UnknownLockfileVersion on lockfileVersion 2, which is the intended guard.
Coverage (89.58% lines) understates tested code because CLI/server paths run as compiled subprocesses in tests/packaging.test.ts; not reported as a gap.
